investigation_notes.Description: An unusually large volume of SharePoint downloads (1450 files vs a 24h baseline of 15) was observed from a user in the Engineering department accessing a Human Resources Confidential site and restricted payroll, tax, and legal paths. The activity originated from Đồng Hới, Vietnam at 2026-01-31T23:58:45Z (local time 2026-02-01 06:58:45), which is outside typical working hours and follows a recent login-location anomaly for the same user and IP. The combination of high-volume access, role-to-data mismatch, sensitive content accessed, and a related anomalous login increases the likelihood of unauthorized access or data exfiltration, so this is classified as high priority.
investigation_notes.Related Alerts: SOC-14215: User Login Location Anomaly (2026-01-31T23:40:12.000Z) — same user, same source IP
